Ms. Sangeeta Shinde,, App for the State.

Coram : Bharati Dangre & Shyam C. Chandak, Jj Dated : 24th December, 2025 P.C:-
1

The petition seek quashing of the FIR and the resultant charge-sheet filed by respondent no.2, invoking Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 r/w Section 34 of the IPC,
against the petitioners, being the husband and his relations.
2
Issue notice to respondent no.3, making it returnable on 19/1/2026.
In addition to the Court notice, notice is also permitted to be served through private mode of service, including electronic mode of service.

Ms. Shinde waive notice on behalf of respondent nos. 1 and 2.
